pages.text: The Echo of the Transcendental is a standing wave: it rings at its own frequency f₀ and nowhere else. The Logos coils hold it in the throat with a field B; the pump drives it. A driven resonator answers with a Lorentzian, A(f) = 1/(1 + (2Q·(f − f₀)/f₀)²): only a drive tuned to within f₀/2Q is heard at all. The playback power is the pump power the echo actually absorbs.
$(thing)Set$(): Logos coil current, Drive frequency, Pump power.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): The Echo drifts: its quality factor falls to Q₀/(1 + |d|) and its frequency wanders by 0.01%·d.

$(thing)Limits$(): Throat field too weak to hold the Echo; Field above 70 T: the throat is tearing; More than 20 GW of drive is not being absorbed: the throat overheats; The throat is overheating.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): The Transcendental rebuilds as fast as the Echo absorbs power.

$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Throat field: B = 0.8·I$(br)Echo frequency: f₀(1 + 10⁻⁴·d)$(br)Quality factor: Q = Q₀/(1 + |d|)$(br)Detuning: δ = (f − f₀)/f₀$(br)Resonant response: A = 1/(1 + (2Qδ)²)$(br)Playback power: P = P_pump·A$(br)Wasted power: P_pump·(1 − A)
